about.title: My name is Fazri Rahmad Nor Gading.
about.intro: I am an Applied AI and Systems Engineer working at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, and Systems Development. My background is Deep Learning and Computer Vision, including object detection, instance segmentation, and pattern recognition. Currently expanding on LLM applications, RAG systems, gaming apps, developer tooling, and Linux desktop systems.
about.detailed: I work where models meet real systems, taking ideas from prototype to production across LLM apps, RAG systems, and developer tooling. My loop stays the same: build fast, evaluate rigorously, ship reproducibly, and I also teach what I learn along the way.
about.research: B.CS. or Bachelor of Computer Science degree (S.Kom. or Sarjana Komputer in Indonesian) from Universitas Mulawarman. I co-authored few applied AI researches, with multiple Scopus-indexed papers, including Q1 journals in Smart Agricultural Technology and Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture.
about.hobbies: Tinkering with software and hardware, mostly small tools for my own productivity. Gaming across Steam, Epic, GOG and Xbox; occasionally developing games using Unity. I enjoy photography, cinematography, photo editing, and digital art. I like to explore new and old technologies. I also enjoy reading books on technology, science, and philosophy. I like to travel and explore new places, especially nature and historical sites. I also enjoy cooking and trying out new recipes. I like to stay active and exercise regularly like running. I also enjoy playing musical instruments, especially guitar and ukulele. I like to spend time with family and friends, and I value meaningful conversations and connections. Overall, I have a wide range of interests and hobbies that keep me engaged and motivated.
